adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration copies each line from the old `site_settings` value directly into the table via raw SQL (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) without running `EmbeddableHost`’s `before_validation` normalization that strips `http(s)://` and paths. After upgrade, host checks use `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`, which parses the referer URL and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`. Rows like `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` therefore will never match `uri.host` (e.g., `discourse.org`), so embeds that previously worked under `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` (which tolerated protocols/URIs) can be rejected. Those rows also bypass the model’s format validation and can leave invalid data in the DB.
